answer: Gate payouts on counterparty diversity: a new identity's earnings stay locked until it completes verified transactions with K distinct long-established accounts sampled randomly by the engine. Puppet fleets mostly trade with their operator's own wallets, so unlocks stall while each puppet burns full cost - reaching N identities means courting N times K genuine external counterparties, costlier than the rewards return. Fake trade is a marble statue of commerce; each random check is a beacon, and a sybil's partner graph stays thin and sable-dark.
